scope: Current actual application loaders for all catalog courses; read-only structural/candidate audit for continuation. No new authoring.
limits: Counts are not independent editorial, pedagogical, translation, source-license, runtime-execution or learner-outcome verification.
A source URL or sourceId does not prove its linked text was read.
Position and length statistics are review heuristics; preserve existing quiz IDs and option order unless explicitly authorized otherwise.
Practice-solution overlap is heuristic and requires comparing task inputs and worked example before editing.
React uses a different content model. Imported-course hint/rubric metrics must not be projected onto it.
Published stage inventory is distinct from Verified mastery and actual live deployment.
